The '''Cliffspring River''' is a river in the northern part of [[Darkshore]]. It flows from the [[Cliffspring Falls]] out to the sea. The river, like so many parts of Darkshore, is tainted by the local [[Stormscale tribe|Stormscale]] [[naga]] and local wildlife which drinks from it often become sick.
